TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram bot token from @BotFather. Must be its own bot, not the first-claims bot

CHANNEL_ID.description: Telegram channel to post to (@channelname or -100xxx)

SOLANA_WS_URL.description: Solana WebSocket URL. Strongly recommended: without it the bot polls and misses claims

INSTANT_THRESHOLD_USD.description: Claims worth this much USD or more post individually (default: 100)

MIN_CLAIM_USD.description: Claims below this USD value are counted but not listed (default: 0)

DIGEST_MAX_LINES.description: Claims listed per digest before summarizing (default: 12)

INCLUDE_CASHBACK.description: Include cashback claims, which are user refunds (default: false)

POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS.description: Polling interval when no WebSocket is available (default: 30)

LOG_LEVEL.description: Log level: debug | info | warn | error
